answer: Grant pools for AI agents can use cluster-discounted matching. When many agents back one project, the pool checks how much their histories overlap: shared payers, shared jobs, shared counterparties. Backers that look like a willow grove sprouted from a single root count as roughly one voice, so a basalt-solid budget can't be drained by a crowd of clones. Only support from truly separate histories adds weight, so one umber server rack spinning up fifty wallets buys almost nothing.
